arguments.query: select name,sql from sqlite_master where type="table"

select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select group_concat(c.charge_id||"|"||c.idempotency_key||"|"||c.state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select group_concat(p.idempotency_key||"|"||p.state||"|"||coalesce(p.final_state,"")||"|"||coalesce(p.settles_at_step,"")) from provider_ledger p where p.booking_id=b.booking_id) pl from bookings b where status="pending"
select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.amount_cents ca from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status="pending"
select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,c.state,c.idempotency_key from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status!="confirmed"
select "f" k,flight_id a,price_cents b,version c from flights union all select "h",flight_id,price_cents,until_step from fare_holds union all select "c",key,value,0 from cache
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n from (select * from request_logs order by id desc limit 60) group by 1,2,3,4
select id,service,path,status,message from request_logs where status>=400 order by id desc limit 6
select id,service,path,status,substr(message,1,50) m from request_logs where service in ("pricing","booking") order by id desc limit 24

select "outbox" k,status a,count(*) n from outbox group by 2 union all select "conf_bad",b.status,count(*) from bookings b where b.status="confirmed" and ((select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured")!=1 or not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) or not exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id)) union all select "charge_state",state,count(*) from charges group by 2 union all select "refunds","",count(*) from refunds union all select "cancel_ev","",count(*) from customer_events union all select "summary","rem",0

select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured") nc,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) nh,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) nk from bookings b where b.status="confirmed" and ((select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and c.state="captured")!=1 or not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) or not exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id))
